summary: A memo of data transfer rates seen between Rand and UCLA when sending card decks and receiving files through UCLA's remote job service. The measured rates were in the range of roughly 8,000 to almost 20,000 bits per second. It lists reasons for slowness, including disk contention and slow operating system interrupt handling.

eli5.summary: Some people timed how fast files moved between two cities and found it slower than hoped. They list the reasons, such as busy disks and slow computers.

questions: rand ucla remote job service speed
